components.name: site-header
components.behaviors: Displays site name and optional promotional banner; serves as a landmark.
components.keyboard_expectations: None beyond standard tab order; header is not focusable.

components.name: primary-nav
components.behaviors: Provides primary site navigation as a horizontal list of links.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab moves focus between links; Enter or Space activates link.

components.name: site-footer
components.behaviors: Contains copyright information and simple text links.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab moves focus into footer; links activated via Enter/Space.

components.name: location-search
components.behaviors: Accepts a location query; on submit shows a toast with the entered location (demo).
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab to input and button; Enter on input or Space/Enter on button submits form.

components.name: alert-filters
components.behaviors: Checkboxes for alert categories; submit shows a toast with active filters (demo).
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab to each checkbox; Space toggles; Tab to submit button; Enter/Space submits.

components.name: forecast-tabs
components.behaviors: Switches between forecast views (Today, Hourly, 10‑Day, Monthly) without page reload.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab into tablist; Left/Right arrow moves tab focus; Tab leaves tablist; Enter/Space activates selected tab.

components.name: unit-toggle
components.behaviors: Toggles displayed temperature units between Fahrenheit and Celsius.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab to toggle; Space or Enter changes state.

components.name: today-forecast
components.behaviors: Shows detailed current conditions for the selected location.

components.name: hourly-preview
components.behaviors: Presents a short sample of hourly forecasts as cards.

components.name: hourly-card
components.behaviors: Displays a single hour’s forecast (time, temperature, condition).

components.name: day-card
components.behaviors: Displays a single day’s forecast (high/low temperature, condition, precipitation chance).

components.name: month-card
components.behaviors: Displays monthly average high/low temperature and precipitation.

components.name: news-card
components.behaviors: Shows a preview of a weather news article (title, summary, date, placeholder image).

components.name: radar-placeholder
components.behaviors: Static SVG placeholder representing a radar map; labeled 'Radar'.

components.name: login-form
components.behaviors: Accepts email and password; on submit shows a toast 'Login successful (demo)' and redirects to home.
components.keyboard_expectations: Tab to fields and button; Enter on fields or Space/Enter on button submits.

components.name: promo-banner
components.behaviors: Demo call‑to‑action for Premium upgrade; shows a banner with text.
